title: Chapter 288: All Zerg Arms Unlocked
content:
Chapter 288: All Zerg Arms Unlocked

The Zerg Hydralisks and Zerg Type II Toxic Ray Scorpions formed a new air defense force, which was temporarily sufficient to deal with the tentative attacks of the alien long-range siege equipment.

When a large number of alien long-range siege equipment lost the target of the Zerg Zergling, their tentative attacks turned into full-scale attacks.

A large number of siege equipment shells fell, and began to test the air defense firepower network of the Zerg main combat arms.

From time to time, there were shells that slipped through the net and fell on the positions of the Zerg main combat arms. Various types of shells equivalent to the attack power of five-star arms exploded, causing some losses to the Zerg main combat arms.

The Zerg Queen finally succeeded in parasitizing and controlling all the five-star alien heavy cavalry of the alien race, as well as the surviving alien mages.

These parasites recovered from their injuries on the spot, and then withdrew from the battlefield in the direction of the Zerg army with the surviving war horses.

Everyone immediately understood that this powerful cavalry unit and those powerful mages had been controlled by the Zerg with mysterious control methods.

It is difficult to control the evil god believers with firm faith, especially the believers of the Lord of Light like the aliens, who have a stronger ability to resist control.

The powerful control method of the Zerg is feared by people from all forces in the local camp.

When the main combat arms of the Zerg suffered a major blow, the alien army launched a full-scale attack, and a large number of reinforcements attacked the direction of the main combat arms of the Zerg.

At this time, the combat power of the Zerg army was the weakest. Even if the Zerg destroyers resumed fire suppression, the reduction of their combat forces made their firepower completely incomparable to the previous one.

Tens of millions of alien troops, with the firepower support of a large number of ultra-long-range siege equipment, quickly attacked in one direction. Zerg puppies alone could not resist it at all.

The alien army no longer cared about the casualties caused by the Zerg destroyers, and rushed headlong, just to rush to the main combat arms of the Zerg and fight to the death with the main combat arms of the Zerg.

In the eyes of the aliens, as long as the main combat arms of the Zerg are eliminated, no matter how many Zerg puppies there are, there is no need to worry.

With 10,000 five-star Zerg destroyers as the backbone, the killing efficiency of Zerg destroyers is actually very high. As long as the area attacked by the five-star Zerg destroyers, the casualties of the alien army are more than half.

But the alien army can afford such losses. With a large amount of ultra-long-range firepower support, they can be said to have a smooth journey and charge very quickly.

Zerg puppies can only drill out of the ground to fight when the alien army passes by. The number of Zerg puppies that can participate in the battle is limited, and the blocking effect is getting weaker and weaker.

If a large number of Zerg puppies continue to rush up, they can still buy some time, but there is no need to do so. Wu Qing does not want to lose a large number of troops unnecessarily.

Let the alien army rush over, this is what Wu Qing wants to see.

It doesn’t matter if the Zerg destroyers are not powerful enough, just upgrade their strength.

All the two-star Zerg destroyers whose injuries affected their normal attacks came out from underground, transformed into pupae and upgraded.

Among them, 5,000 Zerg destroyers will be upgraded to five-star, and the rest will be upgraded to three-star.

After they were upgraded, among the 150,000 Zerg destroyers, the number of five-star Zerg destroyers increased to 15,000, and the rest were basically three-star strength, and the number of two-star Zerg destroyers was already very small.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The upgraded Zerg destroyers fired again in unison.

The sudden and greatly enhanced firepower coverage attack made the alien army feel a little bad.

The alien army, which had already rushed out of the 996th city of the aliens and was rapidly approaching the main combat position of the Zerg, suddenly suffered a terrible loss of personnel.

The injury rate of three-star Zerg destroyers was very high. After several rounds of attacks, the alien army was full of wounded people wherever it passed.

The aliens, who found something bad, immediately sent out the air force that had been preparing for a long time.

The flying arms of the various affiliated races of the alien race took off from the Jiujiuliu City, covering the sky and the sun, and their number soon exceeded one million.

They flew towards the main combat arms of the Zerg at a very fast speed.

The Zerg air mobile force, which had been on standby, immediately flew over the position of the main combat arms of the Zerg, and together with the ground air defense forces, fought against the incoming flying arms of the various affiliated races of the alien race.

The air was constantly flying with super-long-range attack shells from both sides, and the flying arms of both sides flexibly dodged the trajectory of the shells and continued to fly.

The ground forces of the alien race, which suffered heavy losses, also rushed into the attack range of the long-range arms of both sides. Under Wu Qing's order, countless Zerg puppies no longer cared about casualties. They all drilled out of the ground and pounced on the alien army.

A large-scale melee involving the sky and the ground broke out!

All the main Zerg troops participated in the battle. Wu Qing upgraded all the troops that had burrowed underground to recover from injuries and put them into the battle.

The Zerg army, with Zerg destroyers as the core on the ground and Zerg flying dragons as the core in the air, fought fiercely with the alien army at all costs.

All the Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions that surrounded the alien city of Jiujiuliu, all came out of the ground and participated in the battle.

They either joined the battle on the main battlefield or took the initiative to attack the 996th city of the alien race, regardless of their own casualties, consuming the living forces of the alien race.

The alien army, through the space transmission channel, is constantly sending reinforcements to join this war.

It is difficult for them to accept that a super tribe bows to an unknown heretic race.

In the first Zerg sub-base under the 66th city, Wu Qing began to replenish the manpower consumption of the Zerg main combat arms.

The battle between the Zerg army and the alien army has entered a stage of comprehensive and continuous consumption.

Wu Qing handed over the command of the battle to the queen, and his consciousness returned to his body.

…

The conditions for the Zerg mother nest to upgrade to six stars have been met, and this upgrade is the faster the better.

As long as the Zerg mother nest is upgraded to six stars, the strength of all Zerg can be comprehensively improved, and the Zerg mother nest can evolve to the third stage of the honeycomb form.

The Zerg hive enters the third stage of the honeycomb form, and the ultimate Zerg troops set in the game will be unlocked.

This indicates that the Zerg's technology is completely open and no longer subject to any restrictions.

It also means that the development of the Zerg from now on will rely entirely on the Zerg itself, and there is no designed template to copy.

Wu Qing's body appeared outside the hive, and immediately upgraded the hive around him to six stars.

The hive in the form of a beast cave is upgraded to six stars, and the change is not big, but it already has the option of evolving to a honeycomb form.

Wu Qing immediately chose to evolve and upgrade the six-star hive in the form of a beast cave to a honeycomb form.

This evolutionary upgrade takes a little time. Wu Qing used this time to upgrade all the upgrade options of the various Zerg buildings that have been upgraded again due to the upgrade of the hive.

After these upgrades, the attack power, defense power, attack speed, action speed, self-healing recovery speed, etc. of the Zerg ground and air forces have been comprehensively improved.

There are also improvements to the special abilities of each type of soldiers, such as the attack speed of the Zerg Zergling, the range of the Zerg Hydralisk, and the four abilities of the Zerg Queen.

Once these upgrades are completed, the strength of the entire Zerg combat arms will be instantly improved. The combat power of the Zerg arms that are fighting fiercely on the battlefield has increased a lot, catching the alien human army off guard and causing heavy losses.

Wu Qing has no time to pay attention to the situation on the battlefield.

The Zerg six-star mother nest has successfully evolved to a honeycomb form, and the area has been expanded again. The appearance looks more majestic and the details are more refined. With Wu Qing's aesthetics, it looks much more comfortable.

Wu Qing opened the system to check the changes and found that it was basically consistent with the game settings in his impression.

One building can be upgraded and three new buildings can be built.

Through the technological support provided by these four Zerg buildings, the Zerg has four more ultimate arms of standard templates, two ground arms, and two air arms.

Wu Qing first selected the Zerg Air Force Tower building and upgraded it to a new form of Air Force Tower.

The upgraded air force tower supports the evolution of Zerg dragons into two Zerg ultimate flying units, the Sky Guardian and the Devourer.

Wu Qing builds the Scorpion Nest and the Mammoth Nest to support the Zerg larvae to hatch the two Zerg ground ultimate units, the Scorpion and the Mammoth.

There is also a building called the Pupa Channel, which is the Zerg space transmission channel.

Wu Qing did not delay and immediately chose to upgrade all the upgrade options in all buildings.

The six-star Zerg mother nest in the form of a honeycomb can continue to upgrade the reconnaissance, flight and loading capabilities of the Zerg host.

After all three upgrades are completed, the capabilities of the Zerg host and the transport host will be comprehensively improved.

The upgraded air force tower can once again improve the attack and defense capabilities of the Zerg flying unit, so that the Zerg dragon in combat will immediately be strengthened again.

The two newly unlocked ultimate flying units, the Sky Guardian and the Devourer, are also classified as Zerg flying units. The strength is improved through the upgrade options of the upgraded air force tower, which is the same as the Zerg dragon.

The upgrade options in the Mammoth Lair are to upgrade the speed and defense of the Mammoth, which can enhance the speed and defense of the Mammoth, the ultimate ground soldier of the Zerg, to a terrifying degree.

The upgrade options in the Scorpion Lair are similar to those in the Queen's Lair. There are three upgrade options that can give the Zerg Scorpion three powerful special abilities.

Wu Qing looked at the three abilities of the Zerg Scorpion and felt that they were different from the settings in the game. They were abilities that were re-set by the system and more in line with the actual situation of this world.

The Zerg Scorpion is the ultimate soldier of the Zerg, and its ability must not be weaker than that of the Zerg Queen, so the three special abilities of the Zerg Scorpion are very unusual.
